Customer context: The customer is looking for information on where to access the API documentation for LiveAgent.

Customer question: Where can I find the LiveAgent API Documentation?

Solution: You can access the complete LiveAgent APIv1 documentation at the following link: https://support.liveagent.com/840770-Complete-API-reference. For APIv3 documentation, please log in to your LiveAgent panel and navigate to Configuration > System > API > APIv3 documentation, where you can view the latest APIv3 reference directly.

# Documentation

## Where can I find the API v3 documentation?

You can find whole LiveAgent API documentation within your LiveAgent account: 
https://YOURDOMAIN.ladesk.com/docs/api/v3/#/

You can also navigate into your agent panel > Configuration > System > API > API V3 DOCUMENTATION

Image

## 
How can I try LiveAgent API v3 with my account?

Within the documentation, you can find examples and use the possibility to test the API commands with your account.

  1. Consider registering a new free Trial account for testing purposes, before using API with your live account.
  2. Generate API key for APIv3: https://support.liveagent.com/741982-API-key
  3. Authorize the LiveAgent API on https://YOURDOMAIN.ladesk.com/docs/api/v3/#/ and add scopes you need for the API to work:
Image
 
  4. Choose the object (agents, tickets, .) & method (get, post, delete) and press the "Try it out" button
Image
 
  5. Fill the required parameters, press the "execute" button & see the results
Image

 

There are limits related to API and API keys. Here you can find more info. 

APIv1 REST API documentation can be found here.

# LiveAgent My Account section


You can manage your account's billing information in the My Account section to which you can navigate by clicking on the ♡ icon located in your agent panel menu. This section is available only to the account owners, or in case of a free/trial account, to all administrators. After clicking on the icon, a new browser tab with the My Account section will be opened.

### Upgrading Trial/Free account to paid plan

It is recommended to upgrade your account after choosing your plan, finalizing your setup, and deciding the number of agents and optional addons, as it is possible to change your subscription plan only once per day and also to avoid additional early charges according to the logic explained in our invoicing article.

Upgrade of the Trial account can be done by an Owner or Administrator. The person who made the upgrade becomes the new owner of the LiveAgent account. After the upgrade, the My Account section will be visible only to the Owner(s).

# API

LiveAgent’s API enables seamless software communication, supporting actions like company retrieval and conversation creation. Integrate with tools via Zapier, access resources like demos, and enhance customer support with features like collaboration tools and iOS app.

## What is an API?

An API (Application Programming Interface) is a list of commands that one software can send to another. Thanks to API you can reconnect multiple programs, tools, and automate and influence many tasks. Two different software can “communicate” directly via API.

Image: API Integration Concept

## How does LiveAgent’s API work?

LiveAgent’s API enables seamless software communication, allowing you to send information from or into your LiveAgent account from other apps via API. This means you can automate tasks, streamline workflows, and connect your favorite tools without manual intervention.

## Why is LiveAgent’s API valuable?

Integrating LiveAgent’s API into your workflow offers numerous benefits:

  * Automation: Automate repetitive tasks and reduce manual work
  * Seamless Integration: Connect LiveAgent with your existing tools and software
  * Improved Efficiency: Streamline your workflow and save time
  * Better Data Management: Sync data across multiple platforms automatically
  * Scalability: Grow your operations without increasing manual workload
  * Cost-Effective: Reduce operational costs through automation
  * Enhanced Productivity: Allow your team to focus on high-value tasks

## Available LiveAgent API Actions

LiveAgent’s API supports a wide range of actions to help you automate your customer support operations:

  * Retrieve the list of companies
  * Delete conversations
  * Create new conversations
  * Register new customers
  * Retrieve the list of departments
  * Remove knowledge base entries
  * Generate department reports
  * And many more…

## Connecting AI Tools Instead of Custom Code

If you want an AI client like Claude Desktop to work with your tickets directly, rather than building a custom integration on top of the API, LiveAgent’s MCP server gives it a standardized, permission-scoped way to search, tag, and act on tickets.

## Knowledge base resources

Need more help with LiveAgent’s API? Check out these detailed guides: Complete API reference .

## Frequently asked questions

What is an API?
    

An API (Application Programming Interface) is a list of commands that one software can send to another. Thanks to API you can reconnect multiple programs, tools, and automate and influence many tasks. Two different software can communicate directly via API.

What can I do with LiveAgent's API?
    

With LiveAgent's API, you can retrieve company lists, delete conversations, create new conversations, register new customers, retrieve department lists, remove knowledge base entries, generate department reports, and perform many other actions to automate your workflow.

How do I integrate LiveAgent with other tools?
    

You can integrate LiveAgent with hundreds of tools using Zapier. Simply connect your favorite tool with LiveAgent through Zapier, and you can automate tasks and streamline your workflow without any coding required.

Do I need technical knowledge to use the API?
    

While the API is powerful and flexible, you can also use Zapier for no-code integrations with hundreds of popular tools. For more advanced integrations, technical knowledge may be helpful, but LiveAgent provides comprehensive API documentation and support.
